       COUNT(*) samples
  FROM awr
 GROUP BY
       module,sql_opname
),
hist AS (
SELECT /*+  MATERIALIZE NO_MERGE  */
       module,
       ROW_NUMBER () OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) rn,
       COUNT(*) samples
  FROM awr
 WHERE module <>'No Module'
 GROUP BY module
 UNION ALL
 SELECT
       module,
       15 rn,
       COUNT(*) samples
  FROM awr
 WHERE module='No Module'
 GROUP BY module
),

SELECT total_samples FROM AWR WHERE rownum=1

              hs.sql_opname,
              h.samples module_samples,
              hs.samples samples_per_sqlop,
              ROUND(100 * hs.samples / total_samples, 1) pct_total_samples,
              ROUND(100 * hs.samples / h.samples, 1) pct_of_module_samples,
              instances,
              total_samples
         FROM hist h, hist_sql hs,
              total
        WHERE h.rn <= 14
          AND hs.module<>'No Module'
          AND hs.module=h.module
        UNION ALL
       SELECT module,
              sql_opname,
              sum(hs.samples) over () module_samples,
              hs.samples samples_per_sqlop,
              NVL(ROUND(100 * hs.samples / total_samples), 0) pct_total_samples,
              ROUND(100 * hs.samples / sum(hs.samples) over () , 1) pct_of_module_samples,
              instances,
              total_samples total_samples
         FROM (SELECT 'Other Modules' module,
                      hs.sql_opname,
                      NVL(SUM(hs.samples), 0) samples,
                      max(instances) instances
                 FROM hist h, hist_sql hs
                WHERE h.rn > 14
                  AND hs.module=h.module
                  AND hs.module<>'No Module'
                GROUP BY 'Other Modules', hs.sql_opname
              ) hs ,
              total
        UNION ALL
       SELECT hs.module,
              hs.sql_opname,
              NVL(SUM(h.samples), 0) module_samples,
              NVL(SUM(hs.samples), 0) samples_per_sqlop,
              NVL(ROUND(100 * SUM(hs.samples) / AVG(total_samples), 1), 0) pct_total_samples,
              ROUND(100 * sum(hs.samples) / NVL(SUM(h.samples),1), 1) pct_of_module_samples,
              max(instances),
              AVG(total_samples) total_samples
         FROM hist h, hist_sql hs,
              total
        WHERE  hs.module='No Module'
          AND  hs.module=h.module
         GROUP BY hs.module, hs.sql_opname
 )
 ORDER BY module_samples DESC, module,samples_per_sqlop DESC  ,module, sql_opname

WITH
events AS (
SELECT /*+  MATERIALIZE NO_MERGE   DYNAMIC_SAMPLING(4)   FULL(h.ash) FULL(h.evt) FULL(h.sn) USE_HASH(h.sn h.ash h.evt)   FULL(h.INT$DBA_HIST_ACT_SESS_HISTORY.sn) FULL(h.INT$DBA_HIST_ACT_SESS_HISTORY.ash) FULL(h.INT$DBA_HIST_ACT_SESS_HISTORY.evt)   USE_HASH(h.INT$DBA_HIST_ACT_SESS_HISTORY.sn h.INT$DBA_HIST_ACT_SESS_HISTORY.ash h.INT$DBA_HIST_ACT_SESS_HISTORY.evt)  */
       /* 6h.776 */ /* slow on ppts20 */
       ROW_NUMBER () OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) rn,
       COUNT(*) samples,
       e.owner plsql_entry_owner,
       e.object_name plsql_entry_object_name,
       e.procedure_name plsql_entry_procedure_name,
       p.owner plsql_owner,
       p.object_name plsql_object_name,
       p.procedure_name plsql_procedure_name
  FROM AWR_PDB_active_sess_history h,
       cdb_procedures e,
       cdb_procedures p
 WHERE sample_time BETWEEN TO_TIMESTAMP('20250305174436', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') - 1 AND TO_TIMESTAMP('20250305174436', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
   AND h.plsql_entry_object_id IS NOT NULL
   AND h.plsql_entry_subprogram_id IS NOT NULL
   AND h.snap_id BETWEEN 0 AND 1
   AND h.dbid = 979335833
   AND e.object_id(+) = h.plsql_entry_object_id
   AND e.subprogram_id(+) = h.plsql_entry_subprogram_id
   AND p.object_id(+) = CASE WHEN h.plsql_entry_object_id != h.plsql_object_id AND h.plsql_entry_subprogram_id != h.plsql_subprogram_id THEN h.plsql_object_id END
   AND p.subprogram_id(+) = CASE WHEN h.plsql_entry_object_id != h.plsql_object_id AND h.plsql_entry_subprogram_id != h.plsql_subprogram_id THEN h.plsql_subprogram_id END
 GROUP BY
       e.owner,
       e.object_name,
       e.procedure_name,
       p.owner,
       p.object_name,
       p.procedure_name
),
total AS (
SELECT /*+  MATERIALIZE NO_MERGE  */ /* 6h.776 */ SUM(samples) samples FROM events
)
SELECT CASE WHEN e.plsql_entry_procedure_name||e.plsql_entry_object_name||e.plsql_entry_owner IS NULL THEN 'null' ELSE
       NVL(e.plsql_entry_owner, 'null')||'.'||NVL(e.plsql_entry_object_name, 'null')||'.'||NVL(e.plsql_entry_procedure_name, 'null')
       END||
       '('||CASE WHEN e.plsql_procedure_name||e.plsql_object_name||e.plsql_owner IS NULL THEN 'null' ELSE
       NVL(e.plsql_owner, 'null')||'.'||NVL(e.plsql_object_name, 'null')||'.'||NVL(e.plsql_procedure_name, 'null')
       END||')'
       procedure_name,
       e.samples,
       ROUND(100 * e.samples / t.samples, 1) percent,
       NULL dummy_01
  FROM events e,
       total t
 WHERE e.samples >= t.samples / 1000 AND rn <= 14
 UNION ALL
SELECT 'Others',
       NVL(SUM(e.samples), 0) samples,

       NULL dummy_01
  FROM events e,
       total t
 WHERE e.samples < t.samples / 1000 OR rn > 14
 ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST

18:19:59 6k "Active Session History (ASH) - Top PHV"
18:19:59 ASH Top PHV for Cluster for 1 day, between 2025-03-04 17:03:36 and 2025-03-05 17:03:36

WITH
hist AS (
SELECT /*+  MATERIALIZE NO_MERGE   DYNAMIC_SAMPLING(4)   FULL(h.ash) FULL(h.evt) FULL(h.sn) USE_HASH(h.sn h.ash h.evt)   FULL(h.INT$DBA_HIST_ACT_SESS_HISTORY.sn) FULL(h.INT$DBA_HIST_ACT_SESS_HISTORY.ash) FULL(h.INT$DBA_HIST_ACT_SESS_HISTORY.evt)   USE_HASH(h.INT$DBA_HIST_ACT_SESS_HISTORY.sn h.INT$DBA_HIST_ACT_SESS_HISTORY.ash h.INT$DBA_HIST_ACT_SESS_HISTORY.evt)  */
       /* 6k.791 */
       con_id,
       sql_plan_hash_value,
       dbid,
       ROW_NUMBER () OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) rn,
       COUNT(DISTINCT sql_id) distinct_sql_id,
       MAX(sql_id) sample_sql_id,
       COUNT(*) samples
  FROM AWR_PDB_active_sess_history h
 WHERE sample_time BETWEEN TO_TIMESTAMP('20250305174436', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') - 1 AND TO_TIMESTAMP('20250305174436', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
   AND sql_id IS NOT NULL
   AND sql_plan_hash_value > 0
   AND snap_id BETWEEN 0 AND 1
   AND dbid = 979335833
 GROUP BY
       con_id,
       sql_plan_hash_value,
       dbid
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sql_id)>1
),
total AS (
SELECT /*+  MATERIALIZE NO_MERGE  */ /* 6k.791 */ SUM(samples) samples FROM hist
)
SELECT h.sql_plan_hash_value||'('||h.distinct_sql_id||')' plan_hash_value,
       h.samples,
       ROUND(100 * h.samples / t.samples, 1) percent,
       (CASE WHEN s.sql_text IS NULL
        THEN (SELECT g.sql_text FROM gv$sql g where g.plan_hash_value = h.sql_plan_hash_value and g.sql_text is not null and rownum=1)
        ELSE DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(s.sql_text, 1000)
        END ) sample_sql_text
  FROM hist h,
       total t,
       AWR_PDB_sqltext s
 WHERE h.samples >= t.samples / 1000 AND rn <= 14
   AND s.sql_id(+) = h.sample_sql_id AND s.dbid(+) = h.dbid
   AND s.con_id(+) = h.con_id
 UNION
SELECT 'Others',
       NVL(SUM(h.samples), 0) samples,
       NVL(ROUND(100 * SUM(h.samples) / AVG(t.samples), 1), 0) percent,
       NULL sample_sql_text
  FROM hist h,
       total t
 WHERE h.samples < t.samples / 1000 OR rn > 14
 ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT /*+  MATERIALIZE NO_MERGE   DYNAMIC_SAMPLING(4)   FULL(h.ash) FULL(h.evt) FULL(h.sn) USE_HASH(h.sn h.ash h.evt)   FULL(h.INT$DBA_HIST_ACT_SESS_HISTORY.sn) FULL(h.INT$DBA_HIST_ACT_SESS_HISTORY.ash) FULL(h.INT$DBA_HIST_ACT_SESS_HISTORY.evt)   USE_HASH(h.INT$DBA_HIST_ACT_SESS_HISTORY.sn h.INT$DBA_HIST_ACT_SESS_HISTORY.ash h.INT$DBA_HIST_ACT_SESS_HISTORY.evt)  */
       /* 6m.801 */
       con_id,
       ROW_NUMBER () OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) rn,
       COUNT(*) samples
  FROM AWR_PDB_active_sess_history h
 WHERE sample_time BETWEEN TO_TIMESTAMP('20250305174436', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') - 7 AND TO_TIMESTAMP('20250305174436', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_CHAR(sample_time, 'D') BETWEEN '2' AND '6' AND TO_CHAR(sample_time, 'HH24') BETWEEN '0730' AND '1930'
   AND 3 < 2
   AND con_id > 1
   AND snap_id BETWEEN 0 AND 1
   AND dbid = 979335833
 GROUP BY
       con_id
),
total AS (
SELECT /*+  MATERIALIZE NO_MERGE  */ /* 6m.801 */ SUM(samples) samples FROM hist
)
SELECT NVL(p.pdb_name, h.con_id) pdb_name,
       h.samples,
       ROUND(100 * h.samples / t.samples, 1) percent,
       NULL dummy_01
  FROM hist h,
       total t,
       cdb_pdbs p
 WHERE h.samples >= t.samples / 1000 AND rn <= 14
   AND p.pdb_id(+) = h.con_id
 UNION ALL
SELECT 'Others',
       NVL(SUM(h.samples), 0) samples,
       NVL(ROUND(100 * SUM(h.samples) / AVG(t.samples), 1), 0) percent,
       NULL dummy_01
  FROM hist h,
       total t
 WHERE h.samples < t.samples / 1000 OR rn > 14
 ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST

18:20:38 6o "Active Session History (ASH) - Top Latch Waits"
18:20:38 ASH Top Latch Waits for Cluster for 1 day, between 2025-03-04 17:03:36 and 2025-03-05 17:03:36

WITH hist AS (
   SELECT /*+  MATERIALIZE NO_MERGE  */ /* 6o.811 */  d.*,
         SUM(samples) over () total_samples
    FROM (
          SELECT
                 event,
          --     LPAD(LTRIM(TO_CHAR(p1,'XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX')),16,0) addr,
                 p2 latch#,
                 COUNT(distinct p1) num_addr,
                 COUNT(*) samples,
                 row_number() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) rn
            FROM AWR_PDB_active_sess_history
           WHERE sample_time BETWEEN TO_TIMESTAMP('20250305174436', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') - 1 AND TO_TIMESTAMP('20250305174436', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
             AND event like 'latch%'
             AND p1text = 'address'
             AND p2text = 'number'
          GROUP BY event, p2
         ) d
)
SELECT
        l.type||': '||
       REGEXP_SUBSTR(h.event,'[^:]+')||': '||
        l.display_name
--        l.name
       ||' (#'||h.latch#
       ||CASE WHEN num_addr>1 THEN ', '||num_addr||' addresses' END
       ||')' event_latch,
       h.samples,
       ROUND(100 * h.samples / h.total_samples, 1) percent,
       NULL dummy_01
  FROM hist h
       LEFT OUTER JOIN v$latchname l ON h.latch# = l.latch#
 WHERE h.samples >= h.total_samples / 2000 AND rn <= 14
UNION
SELECT 'OTHERS',
       NVL(SUM(h.samples),0) samples,
       NVL(ROUND(100 * SUM(h.samples) / AVG(h.total_samples), 1), 0) percent,
       NULL dummy_01
  FROM hist h
 WHERE h.samples < h.total_samples / 2000 OR rn > 14
ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST

--        l.name
       ||' (#'||h.latch#
       ||CASE WHEN num_addr>1 THEN ', '||num_addr||' addresses' END
       ||')' event_latch,
       h.samples,
       ROUND(100 * h.samples / h.total_samples, 1) percent,
       NULL dummy_01
  FROM hist h
       LEFT OUTER JOIN v$latchname l ON h.latch# = l.latch#
 WHERE h.samples >= h.total_samples / 2000 AND rn <= 14
UNION
SELECT 'OTHERS',
       NVL(SUM(h.samples),0) samples,
       NVL(ROUND(100 * SUM(h.samples) / AVG(h.total_samples), 1), 0) percent,
       NULL dummy_01
  FROM hist h
 WHERE h.samples < h.total_samples / 2000 OR rn > 14
ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST
